1.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers

probes.text: The boys wrap up a long Dungeons & Dragons campaign in Mike's basement, then bike home in the dark.
A frightened girl in a hospital gown wanders into a roadside diner, and the owner takes her in.
The lab's director inspects a strange organic substance oozing from a wall down in the building's basement.

2.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street

probes.text: Staff at the lab sit Hopper down in front of a monitor to watch security footage from the night of the disappearance.
The boys smuggle Eleven into their school, planning to use the ham radio in the AV room.
Nancy argues with Steve, who cares less about her missing friend than about staying out of trouble with his father.
The boys wonder aloud whether a ham radio could be powerful enough to reach someone far away.

5.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat

probes.text: The boys pedal through Hawkins holding compasses out in front of them, watching the needles behave strangely.
The boys corner their science teacher with hypothetical questions about whether a person could travel to another dimension.
Eleven wanders into a grocery store alone and walks out with several boxes of Eggo waffles.
Nancy, too frightened to be alone that night, asks Jonathan to stay in her bedroom.
The kids take refuge in a junkyard, huddled among the wrecked cars while the search for them goes on.
Inside the Byers' house, Nancy and Jonathan each draw a blade across their palm.
